Privacy

Privacy policy

For schools, parents and staff Last updated 2 November 2026

The School Manager is school management software for Pakistani schools. This page covers the website (theschoolmanager.site), the software itself (app.theschoolmanager.site), the Windows program and the Android app. All four use the same records.

Whose records these are

A school uses the software to keep its own records. The school decides what is entered and who may see it, and we keep those records for the school. If you are a parent or a member of staff, the school that gave you your login is the place to ask about your information first; we will help it answer.

What is kept

  • About pupils: name, father's name, date of birth, B-Form number, class, roll and GR numbers, a photo if the school adds one, attendance, marks and results, fees billed and paid, and certificates issued.
  • About parents and guardians: names, phone and WhatsApp numbers, a CNIC number if the school records one, and the family's login.
  • About staff: name, role, contact details, attendance and check-in times, and pay records.
  • Staff check-in: where a school uses the check-in poster, the phone's camera reads its QR code (no picture is kept). If the school has also switched on its location check, the phone's location at that moment is sent once, to confirm the person is at school.
  • Logs: who changed what and when, which phone or computer worked offline (an id the app makes for itself, the kind of device and the app's version), and when.
  • The school's account with us: its plan, invoices and payments.

What stays on a phone or computer

So that the software works without the internet, each phone or computer keeps a copy of what its login reads, and any work done offline until it has been sent. In the Android app this is in the app's own private storage, which no other app can read and which Android does not back up or copy to a new phone. The copies are removed when that login signs out. Work not yet sent stays until it has been sent, so nothing taken offline is lost.

Who can see it

  • The people the school gives a login to, each only what their role allows.
  • A parent sees their own children, and nobody else's.
  • When the school office gives a family or a teacher a password, its key ring keeps that password so the office can tell them again. Once they change it themselves, the key ring shows it is out of date.
  • Our support team, only during a support visit, and every visit is listed for the school under Settings, Support visits.

Each school's records are kept apart from every other school's by the database itself, not only by the screens.

What we do not do

There are no advertisements in the software or the apps, and nothing in them follows you to other websites or apps. We do not sell anybody's information, and we do not share it with anyone except the services that run the software, below.

The services that run it

  • Supabase keeps the database and handles signing in, and stores passwords only in a form that cannot be read back. The servers are outside Pakistan.
  • Cloudflare serves the website and the software's files.

They handle the records only to run the software. Everything travels over an encrypted connection.

The Android app's permissions

  • Internet and network state, to send work and to know when the phone is offline.
  • Camera, only to read the check-in QR code, and only when you check in.
  • Location, only at check-in, and only if the school checks it.

Choosing a photo uses Android's own picker, and printing uses Android's own print screen.

How long it is kept, and removing it

Records are kept while the school uses the software. A school can download a complete copy of its records at any time, including after it has stopped paying. When a school asks us to delete its records, we do, after it has had the chance to take that copy.

Logins are made and switched off by the school. To have your login removed, or your information corrected or deleted, ask your school office. You can also write to us, and we will work with the school to do it.

Children

The software holds pupils' records for their school. Pupils do not sign in: the apps are for school staff and for parents.

Contact

Questions about this policy or about your information: or the contact page. If this policy changes, this page says so, with the date.
